name: Quan Nguyen
title: Associate Professor; Director, Dynamic Robotics and Control Laboratory
department: Aerospace and Mechanical Engineering; Computer Science
fitReason: Very strong direct overlap: current lab develops learned whole-body control for physical humanoids, with reinforcement learning, perception adaptation and dynamic locomotion rather than only simulation.

physicalEvidence.summary: September 9, 2026 ViBe reports zero-shot transfer of PPO-trained visual extractor/LoRA adapters to a physical Unitree G1. A frozen visual encoder and whole-body tracker are adapted for terrain traversal, cube reorientation, object transport and dodgeball. Section 4 identifies a head-mounted RealSense D435i and 50 Hz camera/policy rate; figures explicitly show uninterrupted hardware rollouts, including outdoor and altered-lighting tests. Separate policies are trained per task with a shared recipe; this is not one universal policy. Authors are current lab PhD/MS researchers, supporting current local hardware evidence.
